description: One row of retry_failed_or_partial.csv. Under Artifact Schema 1.5 a retry row carries the requested SHA when no analyzed SHA exists, so a failed acquisition such as the 7ep control no longer loses its requested SHA (plan section 11.4, decision D-2). Artifact <= 1.4 emitted an empty commit_sha in that case, which is why the column stays nullable here.
title: ArchLens retry input row 1.5
